title: trnd

gpu_support.notes: Sampling currently runs on the host RNG; GPU parameters use a gather-and-reupload fallback so output remains resident with matching floating precision.

description: `trnd(nu)` generates Student's t random numbers with `nu` degrees of freedom. Size arguments can be supplied as separate dimensions or as a size vector.
behaviors: `nu` must be a positive scalar or a positive array of degrees of freedom. MATLAB-compatible calls use `single` or `double`; typed-integer degrees of freedom are available in `runmat` compatibility mode.
Scalar `nu` broadcasts over the requested output size.
Array `nu` requires the requested size to match the shape of `nu`.
MATLAB-compatible size controls use integer-valued doubles; typed-integer scalar or vector sizes are available in `runmat` compatibility mode.
`nu = Inf` generates standard normal random numbers.

faqs.question: How does RunMat generate trnd samples?
faqs.answer: RunMat draws a standard normal variate and scales it by an independent chi-square variate generated through a gamma sampler.
